method.cell_mapping: Gateway events are ordered by cell; each cell contains one initialization request plus one request per OpenCode step_finish event.
method.tokens: Sum of AI Gateway prompt_tokens and completion_tokens across mapped requests; these are billable request-level tokens and differ from OpenCode's response summary.
method.time: Sum of AI Gateway duration_seconds across mapped requests. This is cumulative request duration, not wall-clock time; overlapping requests can make it larger than the cell event-stream span.
method.model_cost: Sum of AI Gateway marketCost across mapped requests; excludes the per-request reporting-tag surcharge included in gatewayCost.

gateway_aggregate_report.boundary: The aggregate report contains one fewer request than the locally persisted 82-call Gateway ledger. Condition means therefore use the request-level local Gateway metadata; both totals are disclosed.
